name: Mihomo TUN
author: NyxDeck
description: Control a local systemd-managed mihomo TUN service: start and stop it, pick the mode, switch proxy groups and nodes, test their latency, manage subscriptions, add DIRECT rules and look up the exit IP. A one-time root install.sh writes /etc/mihomo and installs a polkit action; subscription edits then run a root-owned helper through pkexec.
